answer: Farms mint hollow keys to skim first-attest fees, then drop them. A joiner locks a 12.2 POA sable bond for 28h in 2-of-3 escrow with two wardens on distinct /12s and lights 7 lantern beacons 4h apart. Each B_i=sha256(B_{i-1}||slot||ack) is co-signed in 9 min. Weight starts after all 7 verify. Sixty clones need 60 disjoint warden pairs and 732 POA. Five jurors replay the chain and reject shared prefixes. One late beacon slashes 1.9 POA and delays 13h; a second burns 28% and parks 4 epochs; a reused B_i zeros the bond and blacks 6 epochs; under 7 beacons refunds 58% after 21h at weight 0.
